best_for: Windows users and developers who want a free code and text editor that opens fast and runs on x64, 32-bit and Arm64 PCs.

points.title: Free under the GPL
points.text: Notepad++ is free and open source under the GNU General Public License. There is no paid edition and no account to create.

points.title: Windows only, on purpose
points.text: It is written in C++ against the Win32 API and built on the Scintilla editing component. That keeps it native to Windows, and there is no macOS or Linux build. The project says it supports every Windows version Microsoft still supports.

points.title: Small and light
points.text: The project says the plain Win32 approach makes the program faster and smaller than heavier editors. Less CPU use can mean longer battery life on a laptop.

points.title: Pick your package
points.text: There are .exe installers for x64, 32-bit and Arm64, all installing for every user on the PC. IT teams get an x64 MSI, and zip packages for all three architectures run without installing anything.

points.title: Sixteen versions to roll back to
points.text: The Windows listing keeps 16 versions, which helps when a plugin or setting breaks after an update and you want the previous build back.
